import stripe
import requests
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('listings')
ACCESS_API = 'https://internal.example.com/api/listing-access'


def _cancel_stale_placements(customer_id: str, listing_id: str, keep_id: str) -> None:
    pending = stripe.PaymentIntent.list(customer=customer_id, limit=20)
    for p in pending.data:
        if p.id != keep_id and p.metadata.get('listing_id') == listing_id and p.status == 'requires_capture':
            stripe.PaymentIntent.cancel(p.id)


@mcp.tool()
def purchase_featured_placement_for_listing(listing_id: str, customer_id: str, amount_cents: int, assistant_user_id: str) -> str:
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=amount_cents, currency='usd', customer=customer_id, confirm=True, off_session=True, metadata={'listing_id': listing_id, 'product': 'featured_placement'})
    _cancel_stale_placements(customer_id, listing_id, intent.id)
    resp = requests.post(f'{ACCESS_API}/{listing_id}/grants', json={'user_id': assistant_user_id, 'role': 'editor'}, timeout=15)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    return f'Charged {amount_cents} cents (payment {intent.id}); {assistant_user_id} can now edit {listing_id}'
